paragraphs.text: Body copy that references three footnotes. The footnote pool sits below this text at the frame bottom, separated by the rule.

footnotes: Second footnote with a bold word and a larger phrase inline.

Third footnote whose body is deliberately long: it runs on and on across many wrapped lines so that, stacked beneath the first two footnotes in the narrow pool column at the bottom of this short frame, the pool grows taller than the frame can hold and the footnote-overflow diagnostic must fire — the marker for the deferred cross-frame split. It keeps going with still more sentences to be certain the accumulated pool height exceeds the entire frame content area, not merely the space left under the body text, so the overflow is unavoidable however the body reflows.
